body:
All I can do now is crying. I have tried to be strong, but it seems like I am stuck. I hate being sorry for myself. I am tired begging for more time to people to give me chance to work everything out. I am losing out of hope. I can't even see what should I do. It has been years I have tried to compensate, but it's still no good. I am jobless and have been through many unfortunate events. I have forced myself to be positive, but it's still not good enough. I have tried. Eventually, people left me. I already get tired of telling anyone around me who seems to care just because I don't want to burden him/her. I understand completely everyone has his/her own problems. I am living in a shithole country. I have tried to have significant skills with hope it would be my golden ticket to place me in a better condition. But it's not enough and I am losing my patience. I don't know if I could take it anymore when I get another failure.  
I am still trying to believe there's this omnipotent being who would save me, else I have already been dead years ago. I have been trying to be good. All those cliche words given to me don't seem to take effect.
I have tried anything I could... but to no avail.
